_readme: Question set for `npm run eval` (see scripts/eval.js). Every case is sent through the real chatbot pipeline.
Either `question` (one user message) or `messages` (a conversation, last one from the user).
Automatic checks (all optional, regexes are case-insensitive):
sources      the answer must cite at least one of these FAQ sections
noSources    the answer must not be based on the FAQ (off-topic questions)
mustMatch    every regex must match the reply
mustNotMatch no regex may match the reply
Automatic checks are only a first filter: still read every answer in the report and grade it by hand.

messages.content: How can I help you today?
The estimate comes from a regression model trained on Finnish used-car market data.
So why could the final offer be lower?
Is it free to sell my car?
Yes, submitting your car, getting an estimate and booking an appointment is free.
Great. And what should I bring when I come?
